awardsTrip.description: Hit $400,000 cumulative sales in H1 (Jan 1 - Jun 30) or H2 (Jul 1 - Dec 31). Monthly bonuses accrue into a trip budget; ONLY paid out if rep qualifies. RCRS books flights, meals, drinks, excursions, accommodations up to the accrued amount. Rep covers any overage.

monthlyGasCard.description: $500 gas card to top sales inspector each month (min $75K in sales)

officeBonusStructure.description: Per every $100,000 over $1,000,000 quarterly by all inspectors combined
